meta.homeTitle: WallHaze — AI Wallpapers for Every Screen
meta.homeDescription: Create stunning AI wallpapers made for your device. Explore unique styles — anime, cyberpunk, fantasy and more — in high quality for phone, tablet and desktop.
meta.studioDescription: The WallHaze studio: describe your wallpaper, pick a style, choose your device and aspect ratio, add a reference image and generate high-quality AI wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop.

hero.subtitle: Create stunning AI wallpapers made for your device.
hero.footnote: Free during early preview · No sign-up required · Phone, tablet & desktop

gallery.title: Explore ready-made wallpapers
gallery.subtitle: Browse curated demo wallpapers by category — tap any piece to load its look into the generator. Wallpapers you generate are kept in your library, never mixed in here.
gallery.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, style or mood…
gallery.emptyBody: Try a different search or another category.

generator.homeSubtitle: Pick a style, choose your device — prompts and reference images are optional.
generator.modelDefaultHint: Model default size — pick a preset for an exact resolution.
generator.screenRecommendNoExact: No exact match for your screen’s aspect ratio — a general-purpose size is suggested.
generator.promptPlaceholder: Describe your wallpaper — a neon skyline, a dreamy meadow, anything you imagine…
generator.useExampleConfirm: Use this example for your prompt?
generator.promptChangedNotice: Your prompt changed since you picked this — Append will add it to the current text.
generator.appendExceedsLimit: Appending would exceed the {limit}-character limit — shorten your prompt first.
generator.refWillBeUsed: Will be used as the base for your generation
generator.uploadFormats: PNG, JPG or WebP — up to 5 MB
generator.uploadHint: Used as the base for your generation
generator.refUnsupportedFormat: Unsupported format — please use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
generator.refEmptyFile: That file is empty — please choose a valid image.
generator.refTooLarge: Image is too large — please keep it under 5 MB.
generator.refReadFailed: That image could not be read. Please try another file.
generator.promptTooLong: Your prompt is too long — please keep it under {limit} characters.
generator.generateFailed: Image generation failed. Please try again.
generator.invalidResponse: The image service returned an invalid response. Please try again.
generator.networkError: Network error — could not start generation. Please try again.
generator.statusGenerating: Generating your wallpaper — this usually takes a few seconds…
generator.statusLongWait: Still working — detailed prompts and reference images can take up to a minute.
generator.statusErrorKept: Generation failed — showing your previous result.
generator.statusSuccess: Your generated wallpaper — fresh from the AI studio.
generator.statusDemo: Demo preview — sample artwork for illustration, not a generated result.
generator.imageGoneNotice: This image is no longer available at its original URL — your prompt, style and device are preserved, so you can generate again.
generator.restoreConfirm: Reuse these settings? Your current prompt will be replaced.
generator.clearHistoryConfirm: Clear all generation history? This cannot be undone.
generator.favoritesEmpty: No favorites yet — tap the heart on any gallery wallpaper or generation result to keep it here.
generator.historyEmpty: Nothing here yet — wallpapers you generate are saved on this device only.

studio.subtitle: Everything you need to design, generate and collect wallpapers — prompt it, pick a style, dial in the ratio, and save what you love.

popular.title: Find a look you love
popular.subtitle: Six signature styles, hand-tuned by our studio. Tap one to load it into the generator.

why.title: Built for beautiful screens
why.deviceBody: Every wallpaper is crafted to fit phones, tablets and desktops — sharp edge to edge on any screen.
why.stylesBody: From anime to surreal dreamscapes, discover looks you won’t find in any stock library.
why.qualityBody: High-resolution renders with rich color and detail, tuned to make every pixel count.

cta.title: Ready to transform your screen?
cta.body: Pick a style, choose your device and create a wallpaper that’s unmistakably yours.

footer.tagline: AI wallpapers made for your device — create, explore and make every screen yours.
